# BDSubMerge 1.0.2-beta.1

This prerelease lets users test the first set of fixes following v1.0.1.

## Highlights

- The subtitle filename column now remains expanded when the window has enough space, while all
  columns remain manually resizable and full paths remain available in tooltips.
- Chapter boundary option lists are wide enough to show chapter IDs and times without forcing the
  compact table cells to grow.
- Timeline labels retain their normal shape and size during mouse-wheel zoom.
- Merge, output, and report diagnostics now fall back to their Simplified Chinese base messages.
  The warning for subtitle events shifted to or before zero also explains the applied time offset.
- Repeated warnings are grouped as a count in the GUI without hiding them from merge-report totals.
- Near-exact duration matches are no longer marked low confidence only because another local
  candidate is close. Materially inaccurate ambiguous matches are still treated as low confidence.

## Validation

The release commit is required to pass Python 3.12 CI on Ubuntu and Windows, the Windows SMB/UNC
acceptance job, packaged GUI evidence, a no-Python executable smoke test, and SHA-256 verification.

**Full Changelog**: [v1.0.1...v1.0.2-beta.1](https://github.com/YuSaZh/BDSubMerge/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2-beta.1)
